race.comment: GODWITS (1) brings the strongest recent form after a dominant Dubbo win, where he beat D'Oro Choice by four and a half lengths after being prominent in betting. His Bathurst second to Prefer Diamonds the run prior was also solid, and Jake Pracey-Holmes staying aboard adds continuity. LADY TINO (2) is the immediate danger, backing up quickly from a BM58 win at this track and distance, with one win and two placings from four attempts over this course and trip. DUNEDIN (4) has not been winning, but his sixth behind LADY TINO last week was better than the finishing position suggests and the weight relief with Leeshelle Small's claim gives him a place case. HARRIET (6) starting to put it all together this prep and chasing her third straight victory today. Should handle the rise in grade and can take a hand in the finish.
